task_description.overview: Load seismic waveform data into ObsPy Stream objects from remote URLs.
steps: Import the read function from obspy.core.
Call read() with the URL of a seismic data file to create a Stream.
Verify the Stream contents by printing the number of traces and their metadata.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load seismic waveform data from {waveform_paths}. Plot and visualize the waveform. 
 Note: 1) Save the waveform plot to {result_plot}.
